objective: I can decide if a table shows a proportional relationship by checking the ratio in every row.
standard: 7.RP.A.2a — decide whether two quantities are proportional

sections.prompt: A recipe uses **2 cups of flour for 3 batches** of cookies. Fill in the table.
sections.es: Completa la tabla: 2 tazas de harina por 3 tandas.
sections.vi: Điền vào bảng: 2 cốc bột cho 3 mẻ bánh.

sections.text: Both tables go up by the same amount each row.

sections.label: Key words
sections.text: A table is **proportional** when every row has the same **ratio**. The **unit rate** is that ratio for one: the cost of one snow cone.
sections.es: Proporcional: cada fila tiene la misma razón.
sections.vi: Tỉ lệ thuận: mỗi hàng có cùng tỉ số.
Bảng nào tỉ lệ thuận? Khoanh một.

sections.prompt: Test every row. Divide the cost by the number. Is the unit rate the same in every row?
sections.es: Divide el costo entre el número en cada fila. ¿Es igual?
sections.vi: Chia giá cho số lượng ở mỗi hàng. Có bằng nhau không?

sections.prompt: A faucet drips into a bucket. Is this table **proportional**? Test every row.
sections.vi: Quan hệ này có tỉ lệ thuận không? Kiểm tra từng hàng.
stems: It is / is not proportional because

sections.prompt: A shop engraves names on phone cases. Is the cost **proportional** to the number of letters?
sections.es: ¿El costo es proporcional al número de letras?
sections.vi: Giá có tỉ lệ thuận với số chữ không?
parts: (a) Test every row. Is it proportional? Explain.
(b) The shop drops its $6 setup fee. Make the new table for 1, 2 and 4 letters. Is it proportional now?
stems: It is / is not proportional because

sections.text: Ana says: "The engraving cost goes up by $2 for each letter, so it is proportional."

sections.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with Ana? Would a graph of her table go through (0, 0)? Talk with your partner first, then write.
sections.es: ¿Estás de acuerdo con Ana? ¿La gráfica pasa por (0, 0)?
sections.vi: Em có đồng ý với Ana không? Đồ thị có đi qua (0, 0) không?
stems: I agree / disagree with Ana because
At 0 letters the cost is ______, so the graph
The ratio in each row is

sections.prompt: Is the cost of movie tickets **proportional** to the number of tickets? Show your test and explain.
sections.es: ¿Es proporcional? Muestra tu prueba y explica.
sections.vi: Giá vé có tỉ lệ thuận không? Cho thấy cách kiểm tra và giải thích.
stems: So it is / is not proportional because

sections.prompt: Which part was hardest? What made it hard?
sections.vi: Phần nào khó nhất? Vì sao?
